title: संस्कृति निर्माणया आधार
nepali: जंगली अवस्थां सभ्य जुयाः म्वाय्‌स:गु अवस्थाधुंकाः मनूतय्‌सं थःगु बुद्धि विवेक छेलाः चिन्तन याय्‌गु झोलय्‌ संस्कृतिया निर्माण जुल । मनूतय्‌गु मजीमगाःगु आवश्यकता पूवंकेगु धैगु सभ्यता खःसा सभ्य जुयाः गुकथं म्वाय्‌गु धैगु चिन्तनया उपज संस्कृति खः । लं पुनेगु, बाजं थाय्‌गु सभ्यताया चिं खःसा लं पुनेगु बाजं थाय्‌गु कलात्मक चिन्तन संस्कृति खः । थुजोःगु चिन्तनय्‌ उगु थाय्‌या लकस, मौसम, प्राकृतिक वस्तु, भूगोलं तःधंगु भूमिका म्हिती । पर्यावरणपाखें मनूतय्‌सं थःगु शारीरिक अस्तित्व लेंकातय्‌गु कुतः यानाचोनी । थः व थः चोनागु समाजया अस्तित्व लेंकेगु, निरन्तरता बीगु लागि याःगु मंकाः कुतःपाखें संस्कृतिया जन्म जुइ । संस्कृत भाषाय्‌ परिष्कृतया अर्थय्‌ छेलातःगु खनेदु । थुगु चोसुइ नेपाःगाःया नेवाःतय्‌सं न्ह्याकाचोंगु संस्कृतियात लिधँसा दय्‌कागु दु । भौगोलिक, धार्मिक आस्थाकथं नेवाः संस्कृति निर्माण जुयाचोंगु खनेदु । नेवाः संस्कृति निर्माणया आधार हिन्दू बौद्ध दर्शन चिन्तनपाखें प्रभावित खनेदुसा थुगु चिन्तनया मूल आधार पर्यावरण हे खनेदु । जुलियन स्टेवार्डया सांस्कृतिक पर्यावरणया सिद्धान्तयात थुगु चोसुइ छेलेगु जुइ । जुलियन स्टेवार्डया धारणाकथं पर्यावरणपाखें मनूया जीवनय्‌ प्रत्यक्ष असर लाकी । उगु थाय्‌या लकसया अन्तरक्रियापाखें हे विशिष्ट संस्कृतिया विकास जुइ । प्रकृतिनाप संघर्ष याय्‌बले सुनां त्याकेफै वयागु अस्तित्व लेनाचोनी । सु संघर्षय्‌ बुइ व लोप जुइ डार्बिनया विकासवादी सिद्धान्तया आधारय्‌ जुलियन स्टेवार्डं संस्कृतिया निर्माण पर्यावरणया आधारं जुइ धैगु सांस्कृतिक पर्यावरणया सिद्धान्तयात परिक्षण याय्‌कथं थुगु चोसु तयार जूगु दु ।
american_english: After reaching a state of knowing how to live by becoming civilized from a wild state, culture was created in the course of humans engaging in contemplation by utilizing their intellect and discernment. While fulfilling essential needs is civilization, culture is the product of contemplation on how to live after becoming civilized. While wearing clothes and playing musical instruments is a sign of civilization, the artistic contemplation of wearing clothes and playing musical instruments is culture. In such contemplation, the environment, weather, natural elements, and geography of that place play a major role. Through the environment, humans continually make efforts to sustain their physical existence. Culture is born from the collective effort made to sustain the existence of, and provide continuity to, oneself and the society in which one lives. In the Sanskrit language, it is seen to be used in the sense of 'refined'. In this article, the culture practiced by the Newars of the Nepal Valley has been taken as the foundation. Newar culture is seen to be constructed according to geographical conditions and religious faith. While the foundation of Newar cultural construction is seen to be influenced by Hindu and Buddhist philosophical thought, the fundamental basis of this thought is seen to be the environment itself. Julian Steward's theory of cultural ecology will be applied in this article. According to Julian Steward's view, the environment exerts a direct impact on human life. It is precisely through the interaction of the environment of that place that a distinctive culture develops. When struggling with nature, whoever can conquer survives. Whoever is defeated in the struggle vanishes, and on the basis of Darwin's evolutionary theory, this article has been prepared to test Julian Steward's theory of cultural ecology that the construction of culture occurs on the basis of the environment.
